what: Test data only: for each of the 402 cases, in.yaml, in.json, error and === (the case name). No event files, emitter outputs or symlink folders. No code from the repo is vendored or run.
sha256_recipe: SHA-256 over every file except LICENSE and PROVENANCE.json, sorted by path, each as '<path>\0<sha256 hex of its bytes>\n'. Test T6 recomputes it.
upstream_check: Each vendored file's git blob SHA-1 (git hash-object <file>) equals the blob at the same path in tree 493d388a… (git ls-tree -r 6e6c296a…, or the GitHub trees API for that commit).
